purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Alipurduar

queries.query: Alipurduar West Bengal official cadastral parcel map land records GIS official
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Alipurduar district Land Records page, which directs citizens to West Bengal's Banglarbhumi portal. It also found an official West Bengal ArcGIS REST layer, but the exposed layer is MouzaISRO village/mouza polygon data rather than a qualified cadastral parcel layer.

queries.query: আলিপুরদুয়ার পশ্চিমবঙ্গ সরকারি মৌজা মানচিত্র খতিয়ান দাগ মানচিত্র ভূমি রেকর্ড
queries.result: Bengali first-party discovery found the Bengali Alipurduar district Land Records page, which likewise directs users to Banglarbhumi. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

registryEvidence: The official Alipurduar District Administration Land Records page and its Bengali counterpart identify the district land-record service and direct citizens to Banglarbhumi, the West Bengal land and land-reforms portal. This evidences a local administrative custodian and state cadastral service lead, but not an open parcel API response.

officialSources.observation: Official district page titled Land Records; says citizens can use the Department of Land & Land Reforms services and links Banglarbhumi.
Official Bengali district land-record page with the same Banglarbhumi link.

Official West Bengal ArcGIS REST Feature Layer, geometry type polygon, CRS EPSG:4326, JSON/GeoJSON/PBF supported; fields include objectid, district, mouza, block, id and broad mouza/agricultural attributes. It is not verified as a parcel layer.

source: Alipurduar District Administration Land Records / West Bengal Banglarbhumi lead; West Bengal official ArcGIS MouzaISRO service

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-default curl succeeded; page identified the official Banglarbhumi route. No parcel schema or geometry response was present.
Bengali official page was identified by first-party discovery; it repeats the Banglarbhumi service link. No parcel response was exposed.
TLS-default curl timed out after 25 seconds with no body. No login, retry with credentials, TLS exception, or bypass was attempted.

Official service metadata was available through first-party indexed REST documentation: polygon layer, EPSG:4326, max record count 2000, supported JSON/GeoJSON/PBF, and broad mouza fields. Direct curl timed out after 20 seconds before a response body was received.
Bounded anonymous Alipurduar query was attempted with only safe administrative identity fields and no geometry; direct curl timed out after 20 seconds. No response was retained.

schemaAndCrs.observedService: West Bengal official ArcGIS MouzaISRO layer 3
schemaAndCrs.qualification: Not qualified as parcel identity or parcel geometry; the layer is explicitly a mouza/village polygon layer.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Alipurduar district land-record service via West Bengal Banglarbhumi, plus a West Bengal official mouza GIS layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local/state service leads and a public mouza polygon service were identified, but no anonymous native parcel ID-plus-geometry response or citywide parcel coverage was qualified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
remainingUncertainty: Banglarbhumi may expose cadastral search or mouza maps interactively when reachable, and the official ArcGIS service may have related records, but this attempt could not inspect current portal JavaScript/configuration or obtain a parcel feature. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used as an absence test. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested. No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity and full parcel polygon were observed. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
